title: Growth Engineer, Open Source
text:
WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

SigNoz is an open source observability platform built on OpenTelemetry: logs, metrics and traces in one tool. It's designed for an era where agents and humans run observability together. We are a YC company with 32K+ GitHub stars, and revenue grew 2.5x in the last 12 months.


Thousands of teams run SigNoz on their own infrastructure, and many more install it every week. We want that number to be much bigger. Today we don't know where installs come from, a meaningful share of install attempts fail, and which channels bring our most loyal users


Your job is to grow open source adoption the engineering way: measure where installs come from, make installing SigNoz just work, and put SigNoz in front of developers wherever they start a project, including through the coding agents they now work with.


You will work directly with the founders and the engineers who build self-hosted SigNoz. We are looking for an engineer who loves distribution, not a marketer.




WHAT YOU WILL OWN



1. KNOW WHERE INSTALLS COME FROM

 - Build install-source tracking across every path: README, docs, install CLI, Helm charts, templates and marketplaces.

 - Run a weekly view of installs by source, and of the installs from each source that are still running a month later.

 - Use it to decide where to spend time, and to stop doing what doesn't bring users who stay.


2. MAKE INSTALLING SIGNOZ JUST WORK

 - Find out why install attempts fail, and fix the top causes with the open source pod: the install CLI, Docker Compose, Helm charts, resource defaults.

 - Cut the time from running the install command to seeing data in SigNoz.


3. DISTRIBUTION

 - Ship and maintain one-click templates and marketplace listings: PaaS platforms (Coolify, Railway, Render), cloud marketplaces (AWS, GCP, Azure, DigitalOcean, Hetzner) and Artifact Hub.

 - Make SigNoz the default observability backend in other projects' examples: OpenTelemetry demos, framework and LLM-framework docs, docker-compose starters.

 - Build integrations that bring new users in, with our integrations team.


4. CODING AGENTS

 - Make SigNoz the tool a coding agent installs when a developer asks it to "add observability": docs written for agents, a one-command install, our MCP server and agent skills.

 - Track how many installs agents run, and grow it.


5. LAUNCHES, WITH DEVREL

 - Plan and run launches each quarter (Hacker News, Reddit, GitHub), with DevRel writing and you building.

 - Feed DevRel the topics and comparisons that the install data says matter.





HOW THE ROLE GROWS

This role starts as a solo builder. You will write the code, the templates and the dashboards yourself.


Once we know which channels bring users who stay, the scope grows into running those channels at scale, with a second engineer or more DevRel time behind them.



WHO WE THINK FITS

 - 3 to 7 years as a software, DevOps or developer relations engineer at a product company.

 - You have grown adoption of an open source project or developer tool, and can show the chart: stars, installs, downloads or active users before and after.

 - You are hands-on with Docker, Kubernetes and Helm, and you write code (Go, Python, TypeScript or shell) to ship templates, scripts and integrations.

 - You have built distribution through an ecosystem: marketplace listings, templates, plugins or integrations that other people used.

 - You own a weekly number, and you can pull it with SQL.

 - You write clearly for developers: READMEs, docs, launch posts.

 - You work well alone and decide what to do next from data.


BONUS POINTS

 - A launch that hit the Hacker News front page, GitHub trending or a top r/selfhosted post

 - You maintain a popular self-hosted or open source project

 - Active in the OpenTelemetry, CNCF, homelab or self-hosting communities

 - Experience with observability tools, or with building for coding agents (MCP, agent docs)

title: AI Enablement & Automation Specialist
location: Remote · Brazil, Colombia, Honduras, India, Mexico, Philippines
text:
We are looking for a hands-on AI Enablement & Automation Specialist to help business teams improve efficiency through AI-powered solutions, workflow automation, and system integrations.
This is an individual contributor role focused on understanding real business challenges, identifying opportunities for improvement, and designing, building, and deploying practical technical solutions.
The ideal candidate combines software development skills, automation expertise, and practical AI implementation experience with the ability to work directly with nontechnical stakeholders.
The goal is to deliver measurable business improvements through solutions that are reliable, scalable, and easy for employees to adopt.
Key Responsibilities:

Collaborate with department leaders and employees to identify workflow inefficiencies, repetitive tasks, and operational bottlenecks.

Design, develop, deploy, and maintain AI-assisted workflows, business automations, integrations, and internal applications.

Integrate business systems using APIs, webhooks, databases, and platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, and Power Automate.

Develop or modify custom code when existing automation platforms or native connectors cannot meet business requirements.

Implement practical AI solutions using LLMs such as OpenAI, ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI platforms.

Support secure integration of company knowledge with AI systems while maintaining flexibility across AI providers.

Build monitoring solutions and operational alerts to identify errors, exceptions, and process inefficiencies.

Test, troubleshoot, and maintain production automations, including error handling, logging, retries, and data validation.

Provide employee training, technical documentation, and ongoing support to ensure successful adoption.

Measure automation performance, evaluate business impact, and continuously optimize implemented solutions.

Requirements

Must-Have

Demonstrated hands-on experience building and deploying software automations, system integrations, or AI-assisted business solutions.

Strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication, and application integrations.

Practical experience with automation platforms such as n8n, Make, Zapier, Power Automate, or similar tools.

Ability to write, modify, and troubleshoot code using Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or comparable programming languages.

Working knowledge of databases, data structures, and information exchange between systems.

Experience integrating LLM APIs or AI platforms into functional business solutions beyond basic end-user AI usage.

Experience testing, troubleshooting, monitoring, and maintaining production automation workflows.

Understanding of error handling, logging, retry mechanisms, and data validation.

Ability to analyze business processes and translate operational challenges into technical solutions.

Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Ability to work independently, manage priorities, communicate blockers, and take ownership of solutions from development through deployment.

Ability to provide training and support to employees adopting new automation tools.

Nice-to-Have

Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, semantic search, or vector databases.

Familiarity with AI agents, function calling, tool calling, and structured LLM workflows.

Experience with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Google Workspace, AWS, or similar cloud platforms.

Background in business process improvement, UX/UI, or employee enablement.

Experience implementing automation solutions across departments such as Sales, Operations, Finance, Customer Experience, or Support.

Experience developing AI-powered internal applications or knowledge retrieval systems.

Experience measuring the business impact of automation solutions and identifying continuous improvement opportunities.

title: Webflow Developer
text:
We’re looking for a skilled Webflow Developer to join our team. In this role, you’ll create high-performing websites and landing pages that balance sleek design with conversion-focused functionality. You’ll collaborate closely with our marketing team to deliver impactful digital experiences that drive measurable results.
Key Responsibilities

Design & Build in Webflow: Create responsive websites, landing pages, and microsites using Webflow’s designer and CMS.

Webflow CMS Management: Build and manage CMS collections for scalable content updates (blogs, case studies, job boards, etc.).

Custom Animations & Interactions: Develop smooth animations, hover effects, and dynamic interactions to enhance UX.

Performance Optimization: Ensure sites load fast and are optimized for Core Web Vitals (speed, accessibility, SEO readiness).

Brand Consistency: Translate brand guidelines into pixel-perfect designs while maintaining visual and functional consistency.

SEO Setup in Webflow: Configure meta tags, alt text, structured data, sitemaps, and clean semantic HTML.

Third-Party Integrations: Connect Webflow sites with external tools (HubSpot, Zapier, Google Tag Manager, CRMs, forms, and analytics).

Testing & QA: Test across browsers and devices to guarantee a uniform, bug-free user experience.

Conversion Optimization: Collaborate with marketing to A/B test layouts, CTAs, and funnel flow for maximum conversions.

Maintenance & Updates: Handle ongoing edits, new page builds, and version updates without breaking site functionality.

Innovation & Trends: Stay current with Webflow updates, no-code tools, and best practices to improve workflows and site performance.

Requirements

2-3+ years of hands-on experience in Webflow development.

Strong portfolio of conversion-focused landing pages and websites.

Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (bonus: React, Vue.js).

Solid understanding of responsive/adaptive design principles.

Experience integrating and managing analytics/tracking tools.

Attention to detail with the ability to balance aesthetics and functionality.

Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

Benefits

Permanent Work-from-Home setup 

Permanent remote work setup

Competitive starting rate paid in USD

Internet Allowance

Medical Allowance

Paid US holidays

Paid Vacation and Sick Leaves
